description: Exploit, the freeze dose. Run only once the H2.6.2 successor is kept, and on it. Move the group-1 and whitening-bias freeze start from 75% to 60% of steps. The group-1 LR is annealed to 0 by 60%. Everything else is unchanged, including the step count, resolution phases and LR/Lookahead schedules. The truncated step now also runs during the last 10% of the 28 px phase (60–70%), so capture a truncated 28 px variant in build, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as seeds 0–2. Keep if held-out ≥ 0.7545 and seeds 0–2 ≥ 0.753, or if the held-out loss is ≤ 0.1 pp and a follow-up epoch top-up is planned.
